title: Failed checkout leaks stock reservations
description: OrderService.placeOrder opens a transaction but reserves inventory through the root database handle instead of the transaction handle. Reservations are written immediately and survive the rollback when a later line item fails.
reproduction: Seed SKU-KEYBOARD with 5 units and SKU-MONITOR with 1 unit.
Place an order for 2 keyboards and 3 monitors.
The order is rejected, but keyboard stock drops to 3.

failing_test.name: leaves inventory untouched when a multi-item order fails

expected_behavior: A rejected order leaves inventory exactly as it was before the attempt.
regression_tests: reserves stock and persists the order on success
rejects orders that exceed available stock
